The '''super battle droid rocket trooper''' was an upgraded model of the [[B2-RP battle droid/Legends|B2-RP battle droid]], sporting larger [[Jetpack/Legends|jetpacks]] and [[Blaster/Legends|blasters]] than the original model.

==Characteristics==
The upgraded rocket droid's featured was a more powerful [[Jetpack/Legends|jetpack]], composed of two bulky thrusters attached to the shoulders. These gave the droid more speed and control in flight, as opposed to the smaller built-in thrusters of its predecessor. The rocket pack was complemented with small thrusters attached to the droid's ankles. Another significant change was the wrist-mounted [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser cannons]], both of which fired four shots simultaneously to devastating effect.

==History==
The super battle droid rocket trooper was used most notably during the [[Battle of Ringo Vinda/Legends|Battle of Ringo Vinda]]. They were used alongside the droidekas in a final push that forced the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] to retreat, after [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Tiplar/Legends|Tiplar]] had been [[Death/Legends|killed]].

The droids were later assigned the task of breaking into a [[Unidentified transport shuttle (Ringo Vinda)/Legends|Republic shuttle]] to abduct the [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] [[Tup/Legends|Tup]], who had been responsible for the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi's]] death. The droids performed admirably, swiftly eliminating all other clones in the craft and bringing Tup to [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Trench/Legends|Trench]].

==Behind the scenes==
